changes.after: The banner retains its defaultz40 and existing dimensions/text/handlers. Exactly one body:has([aria-modal="true"]) descendant selector lowers only that banner toz30 while a modal exists. Removing the dialog returns the banner to its unchanged utilityz40.
verification: Full current45-line globals stylesheet, exact default bannerz40/ARIA label, RootLayout sibling order and mobilez50/desktopz40 CustomerShell contexts independently read. The selector targets only Cookie Consent under a body containing an actual aria-modal=true element; it does not match the banner itself or alter layout, overflow, consent/auth/session handlers.

Saved final browser receipt independently read: normal1024px bannerz40/text hittrue; short1280x500 modal confirmation hittrue while cookie framez37 (below sidebar40); after closing/logout settlednormalz40/text hittrue. Existing300ms transition produces intermediate values, so computed30 was not asserted.
changes.compatibility: Existing normal cookie position/layer and shared dialog contract remain; source does not add a portal, dependency or persistent four-sidebar changes. Actual local Chromium state acceptance and other-browser/device release checks remain explicit.
changes.recovery: When the modal DOM is removed, the state selector ceases to match and normal consent visibility/layer returns. No consent preferences or session storage are modified by this CSS.
changes.status: Implemented and independently reviewed; actual final first-visit normal/modal/closed acceptance passed

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for payment plans. Added cases include: official v3 envelope retrieves both pages and exposes cancelled-plan drift; empty official catalogue is accepted and cached.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for payment verification contract. Added cases include: verified v3 amounts always use major units, including 100-fold overpayment; overpayment remains explicit evidence for the refund owner.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for payout balance guard.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for prefs security.check. Added cases include: temporary push subscription cleanup succeeds; original notification preferences are restored.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for push boundaries. Added cases include: public DNS result is the address handed directly to the socket, without a second lookup; a service redirect response never triggers a second request.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for savings fee. Added cases include: platform-borne fees never silently surcharge a fractional checkout.

Adds/updates focused regression cases and fixtures for verification flow. Added cases include: a matched live contact code is consumed atomically within its account lock.
